title: The Substitute
logline: A disgraced idol trainee hides as a substitute teacher and a student recognises her voice.
cliffhanger: Jun-ho knows her old stage name Luna. What does he want, and what is his secret?
next_episode_teaser: Pop Quiz: Mina fakes a chemistry lesson while Jun-ho blackmails her gently.

shots.visual: Close on a school corridor at dawn, a young woman in a beige cardigan and a teacher lanyard freezes as a faint singing voice leaks from a student's earphone, her own voice from an old audition recording
shots.speaker: Mina
shots.dialogue: That is my voice. Why is it playing here?
shots.sfx_music: muffled audition clip, single piano note

shots.visual: Mina turns toward a tall student in a school blazer leaning on a locker, one earphone in, calmly watching her as other students stream past in soft morning light
shots.speaker: Jun-ho
shots.dialogue: Substitute teacher? You are early, Ms. Park.

shots.visual: Mina in the teachers' lounge hides behind a coffee cup while a colleague points at a class list, the name Jun-ho Seo, class president, circled in red
shots.speaker: Mina
shots.dialogue: Quiet class, right? Please say quiet.

shots.visual: Mina tries to sneak out the back door of the lounge but runs into Ari Cho carrying a tray of banana milk, who gasps and blocks the way
shots.speaker: Ari
shots.dialogue: You took a teaching job at THAT school? Are you insane?

shots.visual: Mina drags Ari into a narrow supply closet, whispering urgently, the door cracked open so a stripe of light falls across her worried face
shots.camera: Close two-shot, shallow depth of field
shots.speaker: Mina
shots.dialogue: Nobody knows who I was. Keep it that way.

shots.visual: Mina stands before a classroom of thirty students, writing her name on a whiteboard with a trembling marker, Jun-ho in the back row watching with one earphone in
shots.camera: Wide classroom shot, then slow push to Jun-ho
shots.speaker: Mina
shots.dialogue: Hello. I am Ms. Park. I teach chemistry. Sort of.

shots.visual: Jun-ho raises his hand and calmly asks whether she can sing a note for the class, holding up his phone with her old stage-name video paused on screen
shots.camera: Close-up on phone screen, rack focus to Mina's face
shots.speaker: Jun-ho
shots.dialogue: Ma'am, can you sing me an A? Like in this video?

shots.visual: Mina forces a laugh, the students whispering and filming, while Ari watches through the classroom door window, hands over her mouth
shots.speaker: Mina
shots.dialogue: That is not me. That is, um, my cousin.

shots.visual: After class Jun-ho stays behind, the room empty, rain on the windows, and he sets her old audition tape down on her desk, Mina frozen beside the whiteboard
shots.speaker: Jun-ho
shots.dialogue: Your secret is safe with me. Mine is not.

shots.visual: Jun-ho walks to the door, turns with a small knowing smile and says her old stage name quietly, while Mina stares at him in the grey rain light
shots.camera: Medium close-up on Jun-ho, cut to Mina's frozen face
shots.speaker: Jun-ho
